rules.label: Visa Waiver Program: 90 days per entry
notes: Visa Waiver stays cannot be extended.
A short trip to Canada, Mexico or a nearby island during your stay does not reset the 90 days.
Visa Waiver entry needs an approved ESTA. Frequent long visits can lead to refused entry.
Holders of other passports need a B visa. Their stay length is set on arrival, so check your I-94 record.

rules.label: Substantial presence test (183 weighted days)
notes: Counts all days this year, plus one third of last year's days and one sixth of the year before.
Any part of a day in the US counts. Some days are exempt and are not modelled: transit under 24 hours, regular commuting from Canada or Mexico, medical conditions, and exempt visa categories.
You may be able to avoid US tax residency under the closer connection exception (Form 8840) or a tax treaty.
US citizens and green card holders are taxed on worldwide income regardless of days spent.
